note: R-3 corpus-generator input (P2-U1). Aggregates only: counts, sizes, quantiles and shares from an aggregate census of the operator's transcript corpus (2026-10-04). No string, id or path from any transcript is stored here (SEC-101 / C-6). Tool names are the built-in-tool allowlist; everything else is one bucket.

X.note: X := requirements S1 (D11): 200 files, ~381 MB, mtimes over 12 weeks. File sizes keep the census shape (p50/p99 ratio) scaled to the byte target, capped at fileBytes.max.

S5.note: 5x the X file count, one file >= 200 MB.
